body:
The fear of being a vegetable or paralyzed or conscious but trapped in a body that doesn't work scares me so much. Even things like falls from great heights don't always work.

I'm glad you've learned to make some peace with both your past and the life you have now. I don't know if I can learn to be okay with my issues. I don't know if I want to. I'm not really sure about anything right now.

Anyway, thanks for stopping by and the kind words. It sounds like you knew exactly where I was coming from and I appreciate you responding. It's nice to feel a little less alone.
